topic.title: Incorrect all_card_data() text for Team Rocket’s Great Ball (#1132)

messages.content: This has been updated and the data files have been updated. Thanks for reporting.
messages.rawMarkdown: This has been updated and the data files have been updated. Thanks for reporting.

messages.content:
Hi,

The card description returned by cg.api.all_card_data() for Team Rocket’s Great Ball (card ID 1132 / DRI 175) is incorrect. all_card_data() currently says:

Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

However, the official card effect is:

Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for an Evolution Team Rocket’s Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If tails, search your deck for a Basic Team Rocket’s Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

The game engine already implements the official coin-flip effect correctly. I reproduced both branches with fixed seeds: one offered only Basic Team Rocket’s Pokémon and the other offered only Evolution Team Rocket’s Pokémon. Therefore, this appears to be a problem with the text exported by all_card_data(), rather than an engine implementation bug. This can materially affect agents and deck-building tools that rely on all_card_data() as the authoritative card description. Could you please update the all_card_data() entry—and any supplied competition CSV containing the same incorrect text—to match the official card?
